basic_info.description: Tucked above street level on a lot you never knew existed are two cottages in a unique, idyllic and verdant Russian Hill setting. Unit B is the larger of the two, with 2BR/1BA new kitchen, fireplace,bonus room down and south-facing deck. Unit D is a Studio with fireplace, new kitchen and sliver views. Both units have hardwood floors. Buyer to verify square footage, please see provided floor plan. Reuben Law Firm has reviewed the property and said three additional can be added as a matter of procedure. Could be for an owner-user, TIC's or development. In a tremendous location near fine dining and all the amenities of the upper Polk corridor.
